title: Generated API catalog (_lib/api-catalog.json)
description: Produced by richapi-catalog-gen from a pinned openapi.yaml. The spec is a COST-AND-ROUTE source, not a schema source: field_map comes from recorded live fixtures, never from spec examples.

spec_sha256.description: sha256 of the pinned openapi.yaml this catalog was generated from

capability_group.description: OUR taxonomy (plan §1 table), not spec tags. The spec tag axis is incoherent — 8 singleton tags, email_finder=Enrichment vs email_verifier=Waterfall.

required_request_fields.description: 10 endpoints declare none, incl. email_finder and phone_finder (25cr). An empty array here is a KNOWN HAZARD, not a green light — the runtime must supply its own validation.

bulk_variant.description: endpoint name of the bulk form, if any

field_map.description: Response key -> semantic field. Source: RECORDED LIVE FIXTURES. NEVER derived from spec examples — 39 of 68 are >=40% the literal string "example".

result_count_field.description: Response field the charge is computed from. 10 endpoints declare `_list_count`, a synthetic field appearing in zero examples.

billing_field_present_in_response.description: false for 11 of 21 metered endpoints. When false the ledger MUST write cost_status=estimated_unverifiable and never fabricate an actual.

bounded.description: false for the 11 per-result endpoints with no limit-style parameter. Unbounded endpoints page-gate: one page at a time with a confirm between pages.

disabled_reason.description: e.g. post_keyword_search: billing semantics self-contradict, worst case 60,000 credits/call. Disabled until the billing basis is documented.

page_gated.description: Whether this endpoint must run one page at a time with a confirm between pages. NOT the same predicate as `bounded`: people_search and post_keyword_search DO expose a `limit`, but limit bounds the page and not the total, so they still need page-gating. The catalog generator and the cost runtime each computed 'eleven unbounded endpoints' and got DIFFERENT sets because they were answering these two different questions. Keep them separate.
